sutta: 12.16 at sabahti then a certain monk approached the blessed one paid homage to him sat down to one side and said rumble sir it is said the speaker on the dhamma the speaker on the dhamma in what way rambo sir is one a speaker on the dhamma monk if one teaches the dhamma for the purpose of revulsion towards ageing and death for its failing away and cessation one is fit to be called a monk who is a speaker on the dhamma if one is practicing for the purpose of revulsion towards aging and death for its fading away and cessation one is fit to be called a monk who is practicing in accordance with the dhamma if through revulsion towards aging and death through its fading away and cessation one is liberated by non-clinging one is fit to be called among who has attained ibana in this very life if one teaches the dhamma for the purpose of revulsion towards birth for the purpose of revulsion towards ignorance for its fading away and cessation one is fit to be called among who is a speaker on the dhamma if one is practicing for the purpose of revulsion towards ignorance or is fading away and cessation one is fit to be called a monk who is practicing in accordance with the dhamma if through revulsion towards ignorance to his feeding away and cessation once liberated by non-clinging one is fit to be called a monk who has attained in bana in his very life it's the end of the so here the buddha is saying the speaker of the dhamma should be one who teaches with the purpose of revolting towards aging and death to make people see that we should have revolted towards birth aging and death
